ownerQuestions.question: Yeldenne's roster capital is Simoto, the model's site_yeldenne_landing on the Gulf of Minnolomak, about 400 px from the Castle of Yeldenne and the valley of Mp'E it is meant to serve; a one-state realm cannot hold both. The site stands on water as the import reads the land, so the seat is the nearest land, 63 px south-west of it. Should the landing move below the castle, or the realm's seat move to the valley?

Lerendor's North (decision K49) is seeded in the drawn snow country (Lerenwaith); Sonargur lies on the island's south coast with Tolvael, the Heodwa Lands, Hrakbrund and Mustnom between. The map tool joins a realm's pieces on one landmass by a corridor, which will cut through those realms. Accept the corridor, or make Lerendor's North a separate realm under the same crown?
The Low-ness Islands and Ferlinon's pine hills (roster extent) have no model feature; the old map's Low-ness state projects onto the drawn island of Tolhon. Not placed: where are they?
The drawing labels Pornyior beside Argon (now Mount Argul); the roster says "the slopes below Mount Ergo". The seat follows the drawing. Which mountain?

The model puts Ossi Luni (former Hengyang, Soyano's) on the same island as Hol's Great Volcano (Ihuy's seat). One owner per island gives it to Ihuy; Soyano's seat Ileslia is on the northernmost Sun isle (land_island_023). Agree?

The drawing writes Gelbus and Luminor (Olen) on the lowland east of Mirolon, which the model makes part of the eastern mainland (land_eastern_mainland), so Olen, an Ember Lands realm, stands alone on the East and South Lands' landmass (the olen_lowland barrier keeps it out of the Sun Desert and the East Lands beyond). Halia's salt coast stands on the arm of the Mirolon peninsula east of Miherta's tongue, on the central mainland with Mirolon. Keep Olen on that lowland, or move it to an isle off Mirolon's south coast?

Hirolon claims the crests of its proposed ring (the Hiloff Rim from Hirolon Head to the Hilorn mouth, and the Grano; hirolon.md 2.2) and Tirlan grows inside it from Tirbur at the Hilorn's head-streams. Accept the ring as Hirolon's fixed land?

Kingson claims the model's whole Kingson Vale plain (plain_kingson_vale, about 200 by 300 px including the gorge), larger than its three roster states. Keep the whole vale, or claim only the valley floor?

Ten wild lands are left unowned (Mount Ergo, Mount Argul, the Reeto caves, the high Melty glaciers, the Kherith Isles, the Abyss, the Lustras Hills, the Herrodon crest, the heart of the Fallen Forest, the high snows of the Magic Mountains); every one is proposed in its dossier, and whether the game accepts ownerless states is still to be verified in the Linux run (ADR 0069). Where a wild land meets a realm's claim the claim wins: Zol's Mistake's claim (the roster's "Edvoid's Mistake" coast, which the model's zone puts on the Magical Lands' northern tip at about x 3555 to 3645, y 868 to 892) cuts the eastern end of the Herrodon crest. Keep them unowned, or give each to the realm that borders it as the old map did; and is that northern tip Zol's?

Realm sizes follow the roster's stated extent where it gives a state count and the old map's state count otherwise (WEIGHT); in regions where the roster states fewer states than the land holds (the Magical Lands most of all) the realms grow larger than their extent, or the wild lands must grow. Accept, or state extents for the remaining realms?

Not placed as wild land: the Lost Lands (the drawn Lost and Filion labels lie where Andos Enda's seat stands), Dragon Mountain's summit (the roster gives Yavieth the mountain), the dune sea (Wahatud's oases), the Plutondo Dunes (Rhachia's seat stands in them), the Cursed Square (a reef on the water) and the Dark Lands' Death Islands (no land in the model). Agree?

The roster puts Eldafaen on the southern rift shore and its Archive at the southern end of the rift coast; the old map's seat and the drawn Endelond label lie in the north-east of the Magical Lands by the Fallen Forest. The seat follows the roster (south of the Rift Narrows). Which is right, and is Endelond a separate part?

The Triton realms without sites sit on the islands the drawing labels or, where it does not, on the islands the old map gave them: the Seite Islands on the long isle under their label, the Windy Lands on the south of Raerby's arc, Santon on the outer western arc, Halenor on the isle by the Kilos Sound (land_island_059), the Lens on the narrow isle east of Adel, Fineger on the northernmost isle. Agree?

importObservations: Every landmass the realms stand on matches the model's lands: the West and Cold Lands are one land at the neck, the rift coast belongs to the Central Mainland, and the Ember Lands island, the Nether and the East and South Lands are three separate lands.

The model's island land_island_009 reads as two pieces (the drawn passage between Pollos and Benan): Pollos and Benan stand on the northern piece, Nondondor on the southern. Each piece holds a seat, so no realm is cut off.
Mirolon's eastern lowland, where the drawing writes Olen, is part of the eastern mainland in the model and the import, not of the Mirolon peninsula (owner question Q-55).

Three capital sites stand on water or within 3 px of the coast as the import reads the land and are moved to the nearest land: Yeldenne's landing (63 px), Hunhun (4 px) and Mora (3 px). The model's site positions may want the same correction.

The workspace's common/country_tags holds only the 19 October world's 305 old Y tags (00_zin_countries.txt) and the dynamic tags; the roster's 156 tags are written by the mod's build to common/country_tags/01_zin_realms.txt (tools/content/modules/countries.mjs). Until the build has written it, the tool refuses every realm (MAP_WORLD_REALM_TAG_UNKNOWN).
